entities.name: María Belén Pérez Maurice
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: María Belén Pérez Maurice is an Argentine sabre fencer who was Pan American champion in 2014. She was the only representative of the sport from Argentina at the 2012 Summer Olympics in London, the 2016 Summer Olympics in Rio, and the 2020 Summer Olympics in Tokyo.
